  <h1>🏙️ The Rooftop Chase 🏙️</h1>

*KRAKKOOOOM!* 

The Sonic Grenade detonates, shrieking at a frequency that causes the Symbiote to writhe in agony. Venom retreats, smashing through the glass ceiling and climbing up the Oscorp tower toward the roof!

You have to catch him before he jumps to the next borough!

**What is your next move?**
